label: an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry
subsystem: ECAL barrel, one PbWO4 crystal with optical properties

quantities.name: cherenkov_angle
quantities.definition: mean Cherenkov angle (rad) of the photons a 10 GeV (kinetic) muon emits along the crystal axis, detected inside the crystal before they reach a face; per-event mean, averaged over events
quantities.derivation: arccos(1/(n beta)) with n = 2.29 around the 420-430 nm peak (detector-atlas:C141) and beta = 0.99994534 for T = 10000 MeV and the muon mass 105.6583755 MeV (core/constants, CODATA 2022): 1.118864 rad. Tolerance 0.1%: n printed to 0.01 moves the angle by +-0.094% for n +- 0.005; the muon's scattering over the 15 mm before the sensor (about 2 mrad) and its energy loss shift the mean by less than 0.003%.

independence.result: independent of Geant4: a closed form of the index CMS states and the muon kinematics; no simulation enters the reference. Geant4 samples the same relation cos(theta) = 1/(n beta), so agreement validates the optical material, the photon accounting and the reading of the angle, not Cherenkov physics.

negative_control.change: the TDR's index 2.30 (Table 1.1, detector-atlas:C131) instead of 2.29

approximations: one barrel crystal as the S6 case's symmetric trd, 22 x 22 to 26 x 26 x 230 mm3 nominal (detector-atlas:C125), in vacuum

PbWO4 isotropic with a single index 2.29, constant over 420-430 nm (C141): the dispersion and the birefringence of PbWO4 are not sourced; no absorption length (the TDR's > 3 m is a bound) and no surface finish (the depolished face) are modelled
no scintillation: the intrinsic photon yield of PbWO4 is unsourced (only collected photoelectrons per MeV are stated), so the case uses none and measures Cherenkov light only

the world has no refractive index, so a photon reaching a crystal face is absorbed there; the 18 x 18 x 1 mm3 silicon sensor 15 mm inside the front face (efficiency 1, reflectivity 0) is a measuring device, not CMS's APDs, and sees only photons that no surface turned

cherenkov_handling.label: (a)
cherenkov_handling.scintillation: none: the material carries no scintillation yield, so no efficiency map is needed
cherenkov_handling.note: every Cherenkov photon is tracked; the angle is read from the photons the primary emitted (parent track 1)
